violation_type.title: AP Required Admission Information - Child able to swim competently (26 TAC §744.605(16)(A))
violation_type.short_title: AP Required Admission Information - Child able to swim competently
violation_type.typical_finding: The eight admission forms reviewed did not have information on whether or not each child was able to swim competently or had any conditions that would require them to be provided with a life jacket.

finding_variants.text: The eight admission forms reviewed did not have information on whether or not each child was able to swim competently or had any conditions that would require them to be provided with a life jacket.
Four of ten children's records did not indicate by parent if child was able to swim.
